rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Verbatim-frame-cite in reference artefact.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: The `**What happened:**` block is OPTIONAL — default is to omit it.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Line 88: Block violates 3-move standard shape. Move 1 present: count + noun. Move 2 absent: no qualifier on what makes it yours. Move 3 unclear: 'The shapes carry into the close' is passive and vague, not concrete destination
rules_evaluated.fix_hint: Add move 2 qualifier (e.g., 'from your stack') and concrete move 3 destination (e.g., 'Your gap map lives in observations/. Shipped.')

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No combative verbs about the agent in body prose.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No combative verbs found. Agent interaction verbs: ask, read, name, pull, cut are peer-flat

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Headers must be literally true about the mechanism.
rules_evaluated.evidence: All section headers literally name the mechanism: 'Diff the two sessions', 'Read the contrast', 'Cut one stale rule'

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Machine-cadence fat — the shape of good prose without the content.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No empty negation, deictic drumroll, bold-label echo, or citation duplication

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't state a count the adjacent list already holds.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Numerals serve as carryaway-distance recall scaffolding or name meaningful structure, not adjacent restatement

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A slogan that is false as stated is not punchy framing — run the truth test before reaching for rule 12.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Slogan 'two runs are enough to place every lesson' holds true for exercise context; no false superlative

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A claim binds to every body that states it, not just the one holding the stamp.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No duplicated sourced claims in body; backing block holds all vision claims with provenance

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A rule set reconstructed at session start goes stale inside the session.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Single-file evaluation; applies to multi-file sweeps only

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Aspirational destination, never corrective gap.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Frames students as practitioners who read history, rank gaps, cut rules, map work. No deficit framing

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Earn every technical term on first use.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Terms earned in M1-M5 arc or scoped operationally: worktree, drift, verifier all contextual on first use

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Business-audience word ban (Agents 101 default).
rules_evaluated.evidence: AE101 audience (engineers); rule applies to Agents 101 only

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Memory vs context — use deliberately.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Golden path only in body; recovery moves stay below fence or in live support.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Trust Claude's defaults for structure.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Q1/Q2/Q3 retro interview is banned at every module. Compound-shape varies per module.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't smuggle another module's voice.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Don't ask student to manually diff or spot-check Claude's output as error-catching.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: No overclaim of student verification or coverage.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Inline links use target's title, never filename.
